text: dsh-web-search-prism 为 DSH 的 web_search 能力接入 Firecrawl 搜索。它通过 ctx.web 注册搜索提供方，将查询发送到 Firecrawl 搜索端点，并把网页描述整理为摘要、把网页 Markdown 汇总为内容，同时按规范化 URL 去重。适合需要搜索结果摘要和页面正文的 DSH 网页检索场景。可不配置密钥使用；也可提供 FIRECRAWL_API_KEY。搜索查询会发送到 api.firecrawl.dev。

dsh-web-search-prism connects Firecrawl to DSH web_search through a registered provider. It returns result snippets and combines page Markdown, with duplicate URLs removed. Search queries go to api.firecrawl.dev.
想让 DSH 网页搜索同时返回摘要和网页正文。
DSH 的 web_search 能不能用 Firecrawl 搜索并整理页面 Markdown？
Add full-page Markdown and snippets to DSH web search results.
dsh-web-search-prism 的功能「搜索摘要与正文」：发起 Firecrawl 搜索后，把结果描述作为 snippet，并将每条结果的 Markdown 汇总为内容。
dsh-web-search-prism 的功能「注册搜索提供方」：插件加载时向 ctx.web 注册 prism-search 提供方，供 DSH 的 web_search 搜索能力调用。

@hank52168/dsh-web-search-prism README · @hank52168/dsh-web-search-prism：Firecrawl-backed search provider for the DeepSeek Harness web capability seam
(`ctx.web`). Backs dsh's `web_search` tool with **search + full-page markdown
in one call**, fixing the two gaps in the official DeepSeek-backed provider:

| Gap | Official (`dsh-web-search-deepseek`) | This plugin |
|---|---|---|
| snippet | ❌ absent (only `cited_text`, usually empty) | ✅ `description` |
| content (answer) | ❌ never populated | ✅ full-page `markdown` |

@hank52168/dsh-web-search-prism README · Why：The official provider runs each search as a full DeepSeek model turn (no dedicated
retrieval endpoint), so results carry only `url` + `title`. This plugin uses
Firecrawl's `/v2/search` with `scrapeOptions.formats: ["markdown"]`, returning
each hit's full-page markdown in the same call.

@hank52168/dsh-web-search-prism README · Install：The plugin is an npm package that declares itself a dsh bundle via
`dsh.bundle.patch`. Install it with the plugin manager or pnpm, then add it to
your profile's `dsh.profile.bundles`:

```bash
pnpm add @hank52168/dsh-web-search-prism

@hank52168/dsh-web-search-prism README · Configure：The provider is **keyless-first** — Firecrawl's hosted keyless sessions need no
credential. To lift rate limits, set a key:

```bash
export FIRECRAWL_API_KEY=fc-...
```

Or pass it via the plugin config in `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: web-search-prism
  name: '@hank52168/dsh-web-search-prism'
  config:
    apiKeyEnv: FIRECRAWL_API_KEY

@hank52168/dsh-web-search-prism README · Select the provider (⚠️ REQUIRED)：> **Without this step, your search still goes through the official DeepSeek
> provider** (whose `searchProvider: deepseek-official` is configured
> explicitly, so the "only usable provider" auto-selection never kicks in).

Set the provider explicitly in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: web
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-web'
  config:
    searchProvider: prism-search

Or set the env var (equivalent):

```bash
export DSH_WEB_SEARCH_PROVIDER=prism-search
```

@hank52168/dsh-web-search-prism README · Development：```bash
node --experimental-strip-types --test test/index.test.ts   # tests (11)
npx tsc -p tsconfig.json                                    # build to lib/
```
